title: Endless Legend 2
provenance: Reported by NanoAnubis (highball#517, 2026-10-26), Apple M1 Pro, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.22, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, D3DMetal and DXVK tried: the game runs fine, but after the first run no new save can be created, and the game's own log points at an error while handling save files. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Runs on the default engine on an M1 Pro, but saving breaks after the first run for the one report so far. The game is built on Unity, and on the default Wine 10 engine Unity's runtime reads the wrong value when Windows reports a file error, so a normal 'file not found' while saving can become a garbage error. The Wine 11 engines carry the fix (engine patch 0011, made for The Last Flame). That this is the cause here is not confirmed yet. Nothing was measured here.

knownIssues.symptom: No new save can be created after the first run
knownIssues.cause: most likely Unity's runtime misreading Windows file errors on the default engine (engine patch 0011, Wine 11 only); not confirmed for this game
knownIssues.fix: untested: the Wine 11 engine (the environment's settings, Advanced, Engine)
